name: CrossTabDataTableNode
label: Cross Tab Data Table
description: Pivots a data table so that values in a column become new columns (wide format), with an aggregation applied per group.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: GroupByColumns
fields.label: Group By Columns
fields.description: Comma-separated column names that remain as rows after pivoting.

fields.name: PivotColumn
fields.label: Pivot Column
fields.description: The column whose distinct values become the new column names.

fields.name: ValueColumn
fields.label: Value Column
fields.description: The column whose values populate the pivoted cells.

fields.name: Aggregation
fields.label: Aggregation
fields.description: The aggregation to apply when multiple values map to the same cell.

selectOptions.label: Sum
selectOptions.description: Returns the sum of the numeric values.

selectOptions.label: Count
selectOptions.description: Returns the number of non-null rows.

selectOptions.label: Count Distinct
selectOptions.description: Returns the number of distinct non-null values.

selectOptions.label: Average
selectOptions.description: Returns the arithmetic mean of the numeric values.

selectOptions.label: Median
selectOptions.description: Returns the median of the numeric values.

selectOptions.label: Standard Deviation
selectOptions.description: Returns the sample standard deviation of the numeric values.

selectOptions.label: Mode
selectOptions.description: Returns the most frequently occurring value.

selectOptions.label: Percentile
selectOptions.description: Returns the value below which a given percentage of the data falls.

selectOptions.label: Weighted Average
selectOptions.description: Returns the weighted arithmetic mean of the numeric values.

selectOptions.label: Geometric Mean
selectOptions.description: Returns the geometric mean of the numeric values.

selectOptions.label: Harmonic Mean
selectOptions.description: Returns the harmonic mean of the numeric values.

selectOptions.label: Variance
selectOptions.description: Returns the sample variance of the numeric values.

selectOptions.label: Population Standard Deviation
selectOptions.description: Returns the population standard deviation of the numeric values.

selectOptions.label: Skewness
selectOptions.description: Returns the sample skewness of the numeric values.

selectOptions.label: Kurtosis
selectOptions.description: Returns the sample excess kurtosis of the numeric values.
